displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is 0 and digit 1 is 5. The code is 05
meaning: Open circuit. The compressor and outdoor fan have been off for more than 4 hours, and both pressure switches are closed.
causes: Compressor not wired to the control the way the chart requires
diySteps: Check the circuit breakers and fuses. That is the first action on the 05 row. If a breaker trips again as soon as the unit starts, leave it off
Technician: check wiring to the unit, the compressor, and the compressor wiring. The chart says the fault clears after 1 normal cycle, or by cycling 24 VAC to the control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the breakers and fuses are intact and 05 remains. An open compressor circuit is not a coil-cleaning code.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
